name: chat
title: Chat
about: patai's chat app, for each person on the unit.

apis.name: embeddings
apis.title: Documents
apis.about: Long documents found by meaning, as well as by their words.

apis.name: images
apis.title: Images
apis.about: FLUX.2 klein 4B. It takes 10.7 to 13.1 GiB while it's on.

apis.name: search
apis.title: Web search
apis.about: Through SearXNG on this node, which asks public search engines. The app reads the pages it finds itself.

apis.name: transcription
apis.title: Speech to text
apis.about: Whistle on the CPU, or Whisper on the GPU as a choice, for dictation and voice conversations. 0.3 GiB, or 1.3 with Whisper.

apis.name: speech
apis.title: Text to speech
apis.about: Kokoro's and Piper's voices on the CPU, in 10 languages, for reading answers aloud and voice conversations. 1 GiB. Off, the browser's own voices read them.

apis.name: terminal
apis.title: Computer
apis.about: A shell and files for each person, in a container of their own, where patai runs the commands they allow, and a terminal they type in. 0.75 GiB for each person using it.

apis.name: code
apis.title: Code
apis.about: Quick Python, data and charts in the AI API's code interpreter, which starts at once and has no network: a container for each chat. 0.25 GiB while a run goes, one at a time on the unit.
